observations: Photo 0 shows stacks of tires in a storage area, some upright, some lying on the ground. The tires appear used, with visible tread wear. The setting is a simple shed or warehouse with corrugated metal roofing.

Photo 1 shows more tires in the same storage area. In the foreground, a tire has 'R225' embossed on the sidewall, indicating a size. Other tires have handwritten markings in yellow and red on the sidewalls.
Photo 2 is similar to photo 1, showing more tires. The 'R225' tire is again visible in the foreground. The tires vary in tread depth and condition, with some showing significant wear.
No brand names or model numbers are clearly visible on any tire in the photos. The embossed 'R225' is a size identifier, not a brand or model.
The seller claims to be a 'major distributor of Belgium tires', but no Belgian brand or model is visible in the photos.
The tires appear to be used, with varying tread depths and wear patterns. Some have dirt and grime, suggesting they are stored outdoors or in a dusty environment.
